points.K5: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口的访客登记台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a visitor sign-in desk at a lab entrance and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲访客与外来人员管理。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 三个图标：参观者、维修工具、社团旗帜
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a group of visitors, a repair toolbox, and a student club flag. No people.
shots.narration: 参观的、维修的、借场地的，都要管。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 校园开放日，小研带着一群中学生走进工程训练中心的激光加工实验室
shots.prompt_en: On campus open day, the female graduate student leads a group of high school visitors into a laser cutting lab.
shots.narration: 开放日，小研第一次当参观向导。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 一个访客径直走向正在工作的设备，伸长脖子凑近看
shots.prompt_en: One visitor walks straight toward a running machine and leans in close to look.
shots.narration: 有人直奔机器，凑得很近。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 门口，老李提着工具箱要进实验室修通风管道
shots.prompt_en: At the door, the facility engineer carries a toolbox, about to enter the lab to repair a ventilation duct.
shots.narration: 门口，老李也来修通风管道。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研一手拦住访客，一手看向老李，头顶问号；欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the visitor while glancing at the facility engineer, a question mark above her; the panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 外来人员进实验室，该怎么管？

shots.section_title: 欢迎参观，保护访客是第一位
shots.scene: 访客们兴奋地张望激光加工设备
shots.prompt_en: Visitors look around excitedly at a laser cutting machine behind a viewing window.
shots.narration: 想看实验室，很正常，也很欢迎。
overlay: 欢迎参观，保护访客是第一位

shots.section_title: 欢迎参观，保护访客是第一位
shots.scene: 访客熟悉的客厅、办公室图标，和实验室图标对比
shots.prompt_en: A living room icon and an office icon side by side with a lab icon full of hazard symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 可他们只熟悉家和办公室。

shots.section_title: 欢迎参观，保护访客是第一位
shots.scene: 小研走在队伍旁，眼睛一直留意每个访客
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks beside the group, keeping her eyes on every visitor.
shots.narration: 带人进来，要时刻照看好每一个。

shots.section_title: 欢迎参观，保护访客是第一位
shots.scene: 盾牌护住一群小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon protecting a group of small person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 可以展示，保护访客永远第一。

shots.section_title: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同
shots.scene: 访客在登记台填写空白登记表
shots.prompt_en: Visitors fill in a blank sign-in sheet at the registration desk.
shots.narration: 访客进门，先登记。
overlay: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同

shots.section_title: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同
shots.scene: 老周在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank approval form at his desk.
shots.narration: 经实验室负责人批准。

shots.section_title: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同
shots.scene: 小研对访客讲解，旁边空白须知卡上有护目镜、禁止触摸图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student briefs the visitors next to a blank notice card with goggles and no-touching icons.
shots.narration: 进门前，讲清安全须知。

shots.section_title: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同
shots.scene: 访客胸前戴访客牌，跟在小研身后
shots.prompt_en: Visitors wear blank visitor badges and follow closely behind the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 佩戴访客牌，全程有人陪同。

shots.section_title: 登记、批准、交底、全程陪同
shots.scene: 一个访客单独走开的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a visitor wandering off alone in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不让访客单独走动。

shots.section_title: 参观前告知着装，进门配防护
shots.scene: 小研提前给访客发消息，图标：长裤、包脚鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sends a message to visitors before the visit, with icons of long pants and closed-toe shoes.
shots.narration: 参观前，就告诉访客怎么穿。
overlay: 参观前告知着装，进门配防护

shots.section_title: 参观前告知着装，进门配防护
shots.scene: 门口发放护目镜，访客戴上
shots.prompt_en: At the entrance, visitors receive safety goggles and put them on.
shots.narration: 进门发护目镜，戴好再进。

shots.section_title: 参观前告知着装，进门配防护
shots.scene: 穿凉鞋的脚停在门外，门内图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A foot in sandals stops at the lab doorway; a red X over the doorway. No people's faces.
shots.narration: 穿凉鞋的访客，不进操作区。

shots.section_title: 访客在场：通道畅通，暂停吊运
shots.scene: 通道上的纸箱和电线被清走，地面畅通
shots.prompt_en: Boxes and loose cables are cleared from the aisle, leaving the floor open and clear. No people.
shots.narration: 访客在场，通道要清空，防绊倒。
overlay: 访客在场：通道畅通，暂停吊运

shots.section_title: 访客在场：通道畅通，暂停吊运
shots.scene: 起重吊钩停在高处，旁边暂停图标
shots.prompt_en: An overhead crane hook is parked high up with a pause icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 暂停吊装、搬运重物。

shots.section_title: 访客在场：通道畅通，暂停吊运
shots.scene: 访客走到吊运区下方的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a visitor standing under a hanging load, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吊运区下方，绝不能站人。

shots.section_title: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看
shots.scene: 地上黄线围出参观区，访客站在线内
shots.prompt_en: Yellow floor lines mark a visitor area; the visitors stand inside it.
shots.narration: 把访客带到划定的参观区。
overlay: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看

shots.section_title: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看
shots.scene: 参观区视野开阔，能看到设备工作
shots.prompt_en: From the visitor area, the visitors have a clear view of the machine working behind a window.
shots.narration: 既看得清，又在安全范围里。

shots.section_title: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看
shots.scene: 访客一只脚跨过黄线，小研抬手示意退回
shots.prompt_en: A visitor steps one foot over the yellow line; the female graduate student raises a hand to signal him back.
shots.narration: 人人都想凑近看，不能越线。

shots.section_title: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光加工实验室门上的激光警告标志和设备观察窗特写，镜头从标志移到观察窗（设备不出光，无品牌，无人）
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign on the laser area door; visitors watch through an observation window from a distance.
shots.narration: 激光区有警示，只隔着观察窗看。

shots.section_title: 站在安全区：不越线，隔窗看
shots.scene: 访客靠近机门、扒开防护门的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person opening a machine guard door to peek inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠近机门，不打开防护门。

shots.section_title: 不靠、不搭、不爬
shots.scene: 设备台面上尖利的格栅条特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the sharp metal slats on a cutting machine bed. No people.
shots.narration: 设备台面的格栅，又尖又利。

shots.section_title: 不靠、不搭、不爬
shots.scene: 三个打叉图标：靠在机器上、手搭格栅、爬上台面
shots.prompt_en: Three crossed-out pictograms: leaning on a machine, resting a hand on the slats, climbing onto the bed. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠机器，不搭格栅，不爬台面。

shots.section_title: 不靠、不搭、不爬
shots.scene: 警示三角和摔倒图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning triangle next to a pictogram of a person falling onto a machine bed. No people.
shots.narration: 摔在台面上，伤得会很重。

shots.section_title: 留意会突然启动的设备
shots.scene: 设备旁的储气罐和气动台面，标出会动的部位
shots.prompt_en: An air tank and a pneumatic loading table beside the machine, with moving parts highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 有些设备，会突然动、突然响。
overlay: 留意会突然启动的设备

shots.section_title: 留意会突然启动的设备
shots.scene: 气动台面砰地升起，声波图标
shots.prompt_en: A pneumatic table suddenly pops up with sound wave icons around it. No people.
shots.narration: 一按按钮，台面砰地升起。

shots.section_title: 留意会突然启动的设备
shots.scene: 背对设备的访客吓了一跳，往后退撞到架子
shots.prompt_en: A visitor with his back to the machine is startled and steps back into a shelf.
shots.narration: 受惊的人，常往后乱退、碰撞。

shots.section_title: 留意会突然启动的设备
shots.scene: 小研站在访客和设备之间，替大家留意
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands between the visitors and the machine, watching out for them.
shots.narration: 向导要替访客留意，防受惊摔倒。

shots.section_title: 先说清楚，再动手
shots.scene: 小研指着设备的某个部位，对访客解说
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at one part of the machine while explaining to the visitors.
shots.narration: 动作之前，先告诉访客要做什么。

shots.section_title: 先说清楚，再动手
shots.scene: 图示：声音从这里发出，台面这样动
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with an arrow showing where a sound comes from and how the table will move. No people.
shots.narration: 从这里响，会这样动。

shots.section_title: 先说清楚，再动手
shots.scene: 台面升起，访客平静地看着
shots.prompt_en: The table rises and the visitors watch calmly, not startled.
shots.narration: 心里有数，就不会被吓到。

shots.section_title: 拍照拍视频有边界
shots.scene: 访客在黄线内举起手机拍照
shots.prompt_en: A visitor holds up a phone to take a photo while standing inside the yellow line.
shots.narration: 拍照拍视频，只在参观区里拍。

shots.section_title: 拍照拍视频有边界
shots.scene: 访客挤到操作人员身边拍摄的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person squeezing next to an operator to film, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不挤到操作员身边，不打扰操作。

shots.section_title: 拍照拍视频有边界
shots.scene: 禁止拍照标志贴在一扇门上
shots.prompt_en: A no photography sign on a restricted lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 标明禁止拍摄的地方，不拍。

shots.section_title: 高风险区域限制进入
shots.scene: 三扇门：生物安全实验室、辐射工作场所、危化品库，门上分别有生物危害、电离辐射标志
shots.prompt_en: Three doors with a biohazard warning sign, an ionizing radiation warning sign, and a toxic substance warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 有些地方，不对访客开放。

shots.section_title: 高风险区域限制进入
shots.scene: 门禁和访客止步标志
shots.prompt_en: An access control reader next to a no entry for visitors sign. No people.
shots.narration: 未经批准，外来人员不得进入。

shots.section_title: 高风险区域限制进入
shots.scene: 阿杰看到走廊里有陌生人，上前询问并打电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees an unfamiliar person in the corridor, approaches politely, then makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 看到陌生人，主动询问并报告。

shots.section_title: 紧急时带访客撤离
shots.scene: 警报灯亮起，小研举手示意访客集合
shots.prompt_en: An alarm light flashes; the female graduate student raises her hand to gather the visitors.
shots.narration: 警报响了，访客不知道出口在哪。

shots.section_title: 紧急时带访客撤离
shots.scene: 小研带队沿疏散通道走向安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the visitors along an evacuation route toward an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 向导带队，沿疏散通道撤离。

shots.section_title: 紧急时带访客撤离
shots.scene: 集合点上小研清点人数
shots.prompt_en: At the assembly point, the female graduate student counts the visitors.
shots.narration: 到集合点，清点人数一个不少。

shots.section_title: 外来维修人员：双向告知危险
shots.scene: 老李在实验室门口，小研指着通风柜和化学品柜讲解
shots.prompt_en: At the lab door, the female graduate student points at a fume hood and a chemical cabinet while talking to the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 维修人员进来，实验室要主动讲危险。
overlay: 外来维修人员：双向告知危险

shots.section_title: 外来维修人员：双向告知危险
shots.scene: 老李提问，指着通风管道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer asks a question, pointing at the ventilation duct.
shots.narration: 维修人员也要主动问清楚。

shots.section_title: 外来维修人员：双向告知危险
shots.scene: 两人之间双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A two-way arrow between a lab icon and a toolbox icon. No people.
shots.narration: 信息双向流动，才安全。

shots.section_title: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同
shots.scene: 老周向老李交底，桌上空白作业单
shots.prompt_en: The older man briefs the facility engineer with a blank work order on the desk.
shots.narration: 作业前，负责人要当面交底。
overlay: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同

shots.section_title: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同
shots.scene: 【实拍】作业点下方的试剂瓶被搬到柜内，随后手部特写顺时针关闭气瓶总阀（空瓶或训练气瓶，戴手套，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles are moved away from under the duct and a gas cylinder valve is closed.
shots.narration: 清走作业点附近的化学品，关闭气源。

shots.section_title: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同
shots.scene: 小研擦拭消毒要碰的台面，贴上空白提示牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes and decontaminates the bench to be touched, then places a blank caution tag.
shots.narration: 要碰的设备台面，先去污，标明危险。

shots.section_title: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同
shots.scene: 阿杰在旁陪同，老李维修
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stays nearby while the facility engineer repairs the duct.
shots.narration: 作业期间，实验室要有人陪同。

shots.section_title: 外来人员作业前：清场、去污、陪同
shots.scene: 作业完成，老李在登记本上签字离开
shots.prompt_en: After the repair, the facility engineer signs out in the logbook and leaves.
shots.narration: 做完登记，不让外来人员独自进出。

shots.section_title: 社团活动：先审批，定安全负责人
shots.scene: 阿杰和社团同学围着一份空白活动方案
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and club members gather around a blank event plan.
shots.narration: 社团想办科普活动？
overlay: 社团活动：先审批，定安全负责人

shots.section_title: 社团活动：先审批，定安全负责人
shots.scene: 方案交给指导老师和学校，盖章图标
shots.prompt_en: The event plan is handed to the older man as club advisor, then gets an approval stamp icon.
shots.narration: 方案先报指导老师和学校审批。

shots.section_title: 社团活动：先审批，定安全负责人
shots.scene: 阿杰胸前戴着安全负责人袖标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a blank armband marking him as the event safety lead.
shots.narration: 每场活动，都要明确安全负责人。

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室：先培训准入
shots.scene: 社团同学站在实验室门口
shots.prompt_en: Club members stand at a lab door holding a blank borrowing request.
shots.narration: 借用实验室办活动？
overlay: 社团借用实验室：先培训准入

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室：先培训准入
shots.scene: 社团同学在电脑前参加安全培训考试
shots.prompt_en: Club members take a safety training test at computers.
shots.narration: 先完成实验室安全培训和准入。

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室：先培训准入
shots.scene: 王老师在活动现场陪同，大家遵守规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator supervises the club activity in the lab while members follow the rules.
shots.narration: 要有老师在场，守实验室规定。

shots.section_title: 社团借用实验室：先培训准入
shots.scene: 打火机和自带试剂瓶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lighter and a personal reagent bottle, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 活动不玩火，不私带化学品。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 登记、批准、交底、陪同四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: sign-in sheet, approval stamp, briefing, and escort.
shots.narration: 访客：登记批准，交底陪同。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 黄线参观区和观察窗
shots.prompt_en: A yellow-lined visitor area and an observation window.
shots.narration: 站在安全区，不越线，先说再动。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 工具箱和社团旗帜
shots.prompt_en: A toolbox icon next to a student club flag.
shots.narration: 维修要交底清场，社团要审批准入。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在登记台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the visitor sign-in desk.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲实验室行为守则。
